title: Sampling for qEXT and MPN assays: Large-scale One-step Phage Infection of Cyanobacteria
author: Sarah Giuliani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.fi3bkgn

steps.title: Stack filter plate onto bottom plate
steps.instruction: Place the sterile filter plate onto the bottom 96‑well plate without touching the bottom of the filter plate; use the Plate‑Setup Template “a”.

steps.title: Add sample to filter plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of sample from each experiment bottle into the filter plate in duplicate wells, sampling only from bottles that contain test phage and not from control bottles.

steps.title: Centrifuge assembled plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the stacked plate at 1000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Store plates between samplings
steps.instruction: Keep the stacked filter/filtrate plates at 4 °C, covered with a plate lid, while awaiting the next sampling.

steps.title: Remove filter and store filtrate
steps.instruction: After the plate is filled, remove the filter plate and store the filtrate plate at 4 °C, covered with a plate lid and wrapped well with parafilm.
